findings.issue: The '## Verification Steps' section is entirely absent. Template and task-creator rules mark this section as mandatory for all tasks (even report-only/audit tasks — see Task 13, which keeps an 'Automated' subsection and explicitly states why Smoke/User are folded in). Task 11 jumps straight from '## Context Files' to '## Details' with no Verification Steps heading at all.
findings.fix: Add a '## Verification Steps' section between Context Files and Details. Since this is a report-only audit task, an 'Automated' or equivalent subsection can state how the audit report itself is verified (e.g., report exists at the specified path, covers all Context Files, each of Decisions 1/2/6/7/8/9/10/13/17/18 addressed) — mirror the pattern Task 13 uses to justify folding verification into the task's own execution.

findings.issue: Acceptance Criteria is a single prose paragraph ('Security audit report written, covering all files touched by Tasks 1-9, each Decision's actual implementation verified against its stated intent, findings documented.') rather than a checklist of discrete, testable items. Template and checklist require '- [ ]' formatted, individually testable criteria — this reads as one vague sentence rather than several verifiable outcomes.
findings.fix: Break into a checklist, e.g.: '- [ ] Audit report written to work/access-control/logs/working/task-11/', '- [ ] Every file in Context Files reviewed', '- [ ] Each of Decisions 1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 13, 17, 18 explicitly confirmed implemented-or-not with file/function reference', '- [ ] Findings include severity and file:line references'.

findings.issue: Context Files omits the mandatory decisions.md link. The section explicitly states 'No decisions.md ... exist in this project ... so neither is linked here' — but decisions.md not yet existing on disk is not a reason to omit the link: it is a forward reference used by every other task's Post-completion step (which instructs writing a report INTO decisions.md), and sibling tasks created in the same session (11, 14) correctly keep the '[decisions.md](../decisions.md)' link despite the file equally not existing yet. This is an inconsistent, incorrect omission, not a deliberate convention.
findings.fix: Add '- [decisions.md](../decisions.md)' back to Context Files, consistent with Tasks 11 and 14. Keep the accurate note that no project-knowledge/ directory exists (that part is correct and consistent across all 5 tasks).

findings.issue: Context Files lists only user-spec.md and tech-spec.md — decisions.md (mandatory per template/task-creator convention) is missing entirely, with no explanatory note at all (unlike Task 13, which at least states a rationale). Post-completion for Task 15 explicitly requires writing a report into decisions.md, so the link should exist.
findings.fix: Add '- [decisions.md](../decisions.md)' to Context Files, consistent with Tasks 11 and 14.

findings.fix: Either add explicit '**Files:**' (can point to Context Files as the full list) and '**Edge cases:**' labels, or fold their content into existing prose sections with equivalent labels for consistency with the template.
